title: Version 1.2.0
html:
Version 1.2.0

January 21st, 2023

New Content:

  • Added the Grabby Grabber.
  • Added marble at the top of the mountains.
  • Added new variations of stone; these can be collected by refining and forging raw rock material.
  • Added quartz and rosa flamma quartz.
  • It seems like there's an ominous magnetic attraction to rocks during the night as well..
  • New industrial forge and refinery.
  • A new store has appeared at the back of the island!
  • Added beachballs.

Changes:

  • Items now float in the water.
  • Conveyors will automatically open scale mode after placement.
  • Improved pressing B on prompts.
  • You now can refine and forge rocks.
  • Lighthouse bin is now closed.
  • Sell areas now have different rates for materials.
  • Fences next to roads can no longer be collided with.

Bug Fixes:

  • Camera no longer moves when scaling and rotating in build mode on mobile.
  • Attempted to fix vehicles not starting again.
  • Fixed an issue with cancelling deleting slots.
  • Fixed dragging not working with dynamic thumbstick.
  • Fixed delete mode hovering not deselecting previously hovered item.
  • Fixed scrolling frame issues on mobile.

Version 1.2.1

January 21st, 2023

Changes:

  • Internal changes

Version 1.2.2

January 31st, 2023

New Content:

  • Added blinkers, brake lights, and IK steering!
  • Added 3 brand new wide conveyor variants
  • Added fences to various misc ledges
  • Added a new ore, Adurite

Changes:

  • All benefits of Supporter are now given whilst in game, removing requirement of rejoining
  • SFX plays when Supporter Gamepass is purchased
  • Pieces that are too small will now total up and add onto other pieces
  • Fixed chat rank typo
  • Using any form of schematic will now automatically be set to scale mode after first placement on select
  • Vehicle speed is now influenced by colors
  • Temporarily removed tool swinging body rotation
  • Changed the ingot mesh to be less cartoony
  • Revamped Delete mode
  • Disabled the ability to build under your property due to concerns
  • Tools now only drop when you are in a danger scenario

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed lumberjack achievement typo
  • Fixed refinery & forge taking large pieces of material
  • Fixed issue with mobile dragging permission
  • Added support for server to recache a player's tags, and also made players leaving remove tag from cache
  • Fixed ball not deleting sometimes when drag stopped
  • Moved input and output slightly further from each other so thin produce doesn't get stuck in a 'flashing' loop
  • Fixed AnchorTool Anchor Tag not working when model changes
  • Fixed chop line's weld being the wrong CFrame calculation causing floating point issues
  • Fixed issue with mobile and xbox letting go of their respective inputs while using a slider
  • Fixed wrong logic causing lantern light to always turn back on after saving and loading
  • Fixed vehicle controls not being recognized by making a separate system
  • Ban durations are now correctly displayed
  • Placement no longer tries to place even if it is considered 'red'

Version 1.2.3

February 1st, 2023

Changes:

  • Structures can now be placed slightly in the ground

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed vehicles flinging
  • Fixed Adurite typo
  • Fixed time not scaling
  • Fixed interaction not showing inspection

Version 1.2.4

February 5th, 2023

New Content:

  • Added new editable text signs

Changes:

  • Adjusted vehicle constraints

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed vehicles randomly driving on controller
  • Fixed vehicles crashing client if resetting whilst driving
  • Fixed vehicle brake lights spamming

Version 1.2.5

February 5th, 2023

Changes:

  • Signs no longer use rich text, but rather a custom system

Bug Fixes:

  • Fixed more issues with vehicles on controller
